scope_note: This is the generation-12 corrective pass resolving all 3 reopen findings from PR #5620: (1) Strategy adapter command proof: Eliminated false-success 'metadata_updated' reporting by requiring StrategyCommandAdapter._execute_update_params to strictly validate the durable original command receipt from Registry via GET /api/registry/entries/{registry_id}/receipts/{command_key}. Removed duplicate unverified token parser in favor of canonical services.runtime_auth_inbound.validate_request_auth (rejecting unauthenticated requests with 401 UNAUTHORIZED or 403 FORBIDDEN). Enforced strict receipt scope verification (command_key, registry_id, receipt_key, request_digest, non-null committed_at, tenant ID, and caller actor ID). Eliminated entry-only receipt fabrication. Caught ambiguous transport exceptions (RemoteDisconnected, URLError) on PATCH and recovered via scoped receipt readback or failed closed with retryable 503 UNCONFIRMED_COMMAND_RECEIPT (preventing spurious EXECUTION_ERROR). (2) Keyed generic full-spec revision protocol & lock ordering: Enforced globally consistent lock acquisition order across all writers: advisory_xact_lock(strategy_id) FIRST -> entries.lock_table() SECOND -> receipts.insert_if_absent() THIRD. Eliminated reverse lock order cycle in create_with_receipt. Generic POST /api/registry/entries now extracts strategy_spec and passes strategy_id and validate_lineage to register_with_idempotency, ensuring concurrent typed and keyed revision registrations serialize behind the same advisory lock. Added dual-key receipt indexing in create_with_receipt so receipts can be queried by either register_entry or canonical registry_id. (3) Real PostgreSQL crash-window/response-loss proof & stale contract reconciliation: Replaced graceful termination with genuine ungraceful proc.kill() (SIGKILL) in services/registry/test_owner_durability_real_process.py. Added DroppedSocketProxy testing hard TCP connection resets (RST via SO_LINGER) after commit for create, metadata, and advance lifecycle operations. Added deterministic fault injection between state write and receipt write in services/foundation/tests/test_registry_owner_transaction.py proving store-level atomicity, zero partial mutations, and clean retry. Reconciled first_release_contract.json to remove stale no-second-GET statements and document independent receipt readback and transport recovery.

review.decision: Resolved all 3 reopen findings from PR #5620 (manifest blob f76051a9cb0737aaaddb304ee7cf7e35f7e6f86a) and coordinator diagnosis note 1143: (1) Strategy adapter strictly validates caller authentication via services.runtime_auth_inbound.validate_request_auth (401/403), eliminates entry-only receipt fabrication, strictly validates original scoped receipts (command_key, registry_id, receipt_key, request_digest, committed_at, tenant/actor), and handles ambiguous transport exceptions (RemoteDisconnected, URLError) via readback recovery or retryable 503; (2) Enforced globally consistent lock acquisition order: advisory_xact_lock(strategy_id) -> entries.lock_table() -> receipts.insert_if_absent(), ensuring generic full-spec writes share the revision advisory lock and validate lineage under the lock; (3) Added real PostgreSQL ungraceful process kill (SIGKILL) tests, TCP proxy response-loss tests with hard RST across create/metadata/advance lifecycle operations, deterministic fault injection between state mutation and receipt write proving clean rollback with zero partial mutations, and reconciled first_release_contract.json. All 372 suite tests pass against live PostgreSQL.
